title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region residency + audit logging improvements
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region residency constraints and tighten audit logging for KMS operations after recent compliance review. This PR implements a policy-level residency check that prevents use of customer-managed KMS keys outside of allowed regions, expands audit events to include key-residency decisions, and provides a safe rollout path with an audit-only mode. Summary of changes: 1) policy engine: add kms_residency_policy with enforcement and audit-only modes; 2) authz checks: integrate residency check into token/route evaluation path with minimal latency impact; 3) audit logging: add structured fields (kms_key_id, key_region, policy_decision, decision_reason) for KMS-related events and wire them into our existing audit pipeline; 4) config/migrations: new policy config schema version bump + migration script to convert existing key bindings to explicit residency metadata; 5) docs + tests: migration guide, operator playbook, unit and integration tests. Rollout plan: merge behind a feature flag defaulting to audit-only; run audit-only for 2 weeks, review logs for false positives; enable enforcement in staggered waves per org size with opt-outs for legacy customers. Backwards compatibility: no client SDK changes; policy schema bump is backwards-compatible because unknown fields are ignored; migration script provides a reversible mapping. Checklist: [x] policy implementation; [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests (kms residency matrix); [x] migration script; [x] docs and ops runbook; [x] performance benchmark (avg authz latency +0.8ms); [x] security review.

review_comments: Lena Ortiz: Can we ensure the residency check is skipped for system-service principals? Author: Yes — residency_check.go has an explicit allowlist for system principals and we updated tests to cover this.

Carlos Mendes: Audit log size could increase significantly for high-volume customers — any mitigation? Author: We batch and compress audit appenders; added a flag to sample residency-decisions for orgs over threshold and metric to track increase. See kms_appender.go for sampling code.

Riley Chen: Migration may be risky for customers with thousands of keys — is rollback trivial? Author: Migration is additive and reversible: the script writes a 'residency_backup' table and preserves old bindings; ops runbook documents rollback steps.

Security review (internal): please add a hardened path when KMS is unreachable. Author: Added fallback that marks decision as 'UNKNOWN' and defaults to audit-only for affected requests; documented behavior in ops runbook.
release_notes: - Enforce KMS region residency via RBAC v2 policy with audit-only rollout mode. - Enhanced audit logging for KMS operations: kms_key_id, key_region, policy_decision, decision_reason. - Migration script provided to annotate existing keys with residency metadata. - Feature gated behind org-level flag; default behavior is audit-only. Operators: review docs/ops/kms-residency-rollout.md for upgrade steps and rollback plan.
notes: Performance: measured authz p50 +0.8ms, p95 +1.9ms after optimizations. Observability: added telemetry metrics redwood.kms.residency.decision and redwood.kms.residency.latency. Operational concerns: advised SRE to watch audit pipeline ingestion and enable sampling for >1M events/day orgs.
